WTXS21 PGTW 240400
MSGID/GENADMIN/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI//
SUBJ/TROPICAL CYCLONE FORMATION ALERT (INVEST 98S) REISSUED//
REF/A/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI/230321ZNOV26//
AMPN/REF IS TROPICAL CYCLONE FORMATION ALERT.//
RMKS/
1. FORMATION OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE IS POSSIBLE WITHIN
130 NM EITHER SIDE OF A LINE FROM 9.8S 77.0E TO 13.2S 75.1E
WITHIN THE NEXT 12 TO 24 HOURS. AVAILABLE DATA DOES NOT JUSTIFY
ISSUANCE OF NUMBERED TROPICAL CYCLONE WARNINGS AT THIS TIME.
WINDS IN THE AREA ARE ESTIMATED TO BE 23 TO 28 KNOTS. METSAT
IMAGERY AT 240011Z INDICATES THAT A CIRCULATION CENTER IS LOCATED
NEAR 10.0S 76.8E. THE SYSTEM IS MOVING SOUTHWESTWARD AT 11 KNOTS.
2. REMARKS: THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 98S) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED 
NEAR 7.6S 76.8E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 8.9S 78.6E, APPROXIMATELY 376 NM 
EAST-SOUTHEAST OF DIEGO GARCIA. ANIMATED MULTISPECTRAL SATELLITE 
IMAGERY (MSI) DEPICTS A COMPACT, DEVELOPING LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION 
(LLC) WITH FORMATIVE CURVATURE BANDING AROUND THE EASTERN PORTION OF 
THE SYSTEM AND MODERATE CONVECTION. THE SYSTEM HAS BEEN REANALYZED AFTER 
RECEIPT OF MULTIPLE MICROWAVE PASSES INCLUDING A 232319Z GMI 37 GHZ AND 
240016Z SSMIS 37 GHZ IMAGE WHICH SHOWED THE LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER 
(LLCC) TO THE EAST OF THE FLARING CONVECTION VICE SOUTHWEST. 
ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS REVEALS FAVORABLE CONDITIONS WITH LOW TO MODERATE 
(20-15) VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (VWS) AND WARM (28-29 C) SEA SURFACE 
TEMPERATURES AND WEAK EQUATORWARD AND POLEWARD OUTFLOW. GLOBAL MODELS ARE 
SPLIT, WITH GFS DEPICTING MINIMAL DEVELOPMENT, WHILE ECMWF DOES NOT SHOW 
THE SYSTEM DEVELOPING FURTHER. BOTH MODELS INDICATE A GENERAL SOUTH-
SOUTHWESTWARD TRACK OVER THE NEXT 24-36 HOURS. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED SURFACE 
WINDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 23 TO 28 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL PRESSURE IS 
ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1006 MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A 
SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS REMAINS HIGH. THIS 
SUPERSEDES REF A (WTXS21 PGTW 230330).
3. THIS ALERT WILL BE REISSUED, UPGRADED TO WARNING OR CANCELLED BY 
250400Z.//
NNNN
